parts.t: Canyon Springs is one of Coquitlam's most desirable and leafy neighbourhoods, featuring executive homes tucked into a ravine setting near Westwood Plateau. With excellent school catchments, trails, and a peaceful atmosphere, it's a top destination for upscale buyers in the Tri-Cities.
